name: Doorbell Overlay
description: Doorbell camera overlay for Kiosk Satellite screensavers and Fotoo with two Home Assistant triggers and aspect-safe camera sizing.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show overlay on
settings.description: Choose whether the doorbell camera is shown on Kiosk Satellite's own screensavers, Fotoo, or both.

settings.title: Trigger 1
settings.description: Primary trigger, for example a Frigate person occupancy binary_sensor.

settings.title: Trigger 2
settings.description: Secondary trigger, for example the Reolink visitor/ring-button binary_sensor.

settings.title: Doorbell camera entity
settings.description: Home Assistant camera entity shown when either trigger activates.

settings.title: Camera size
settings.description: Camera width as a percentage of screen width. Height follows the camera frame aspect ratio.

settings.title: Camera position
settings.description: Vertical position of the camera overlay.

settings.title: Camera display time
settings.description: How long the doorbell camera stays visible after a trigger.
